STORY-001.true_root_cause: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion caused by unthrottled concurrent worker threads during the Monday morning scheduled payroll run.

STORY-002.true_root_cause: HikariCP database connection leak introduced in Payment API v4.18.2 due to unclosed sessions in the transaction retry block.

STORY-003.true_root_cause: Distributed lock race condition under rare localized network partitioning; no prior recorded incidents or historical RCAs.

STORY-004.true_root_cause: Expired wild-card TLS certificate on edge proxy nodes due to a failed automated cert-manager renewal hook.

STORY-005.true_root_cause: Kafka consumer group deadlock caused by poisoned payload deserialization blocking all downstream event partitions.

STORY-006.true_root_cause: Missing composite database index on invoice table dropped during maintenance, causing full table scans during monthly closing.

STORY-007.true_root_cause: Log rotation failure filling root partition /var/log, crashing active RabbitMQ message broker disk alarms.

STORY-008.true_root_cause: Incorrect cgroup memory limits (256Mi vs required 1Gi) introduced in Kubernetes deployment manifest update.

STORY-009.true_root_cause: CoreDNS concurrency limits exceeded during burst traffic, causing intermittent NXDOMAIN errors across pods.

STORY-010.true_root_cause: Protobuf contract field tag collision between User Profile v3.2 and upstream Gateway.
